[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Rislar''' served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] aboard a [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|customs]] cutter, before leaving service to work as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Starship/Legends|ship]]-jacker. Later, this included a stint working as a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Rislar grew knowledgeable about numerous arms and equipment, and later shared this knowledge on [[Gundark (arms dealer)|Gundark's]] [[Gundark's Gear Datalog|''Gear Datalog'']].

==Biography==
Rislar served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], rising to the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and commanding a small [[Starcutter/Legends|cutter]] for [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]]. On one occasion, the cutter was attacked by a crew of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]; one of the pirates was armed with a [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[Firespray DL-87 stun rifle|Firespray DL-87]], which blew a hole right through the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]], resulting in half the cutter's crew being sucked out into vacuum. Most of the rest of the crew was killed by the pirates, although Rislar survived the encounter.<ref name="GFT" />

The captain later left the Imperial Navy and struck out as a pirate and ship-jacker, in command of a crew. Rislar gave each member of the crew an elegant [[LaserHone/Legends|LaserHone]] [[Duelist vibrorapier]] in order to win their loyalty. The pirate believed this was one reason that none of the crew ever challenged for command.<ref name="GFT" />

Rislar preferred weapons that could subdue opponents with minimal casualties. As such, the pirate often used [[DAS-430 Neural Inhibitor/Legends|DAS-430 Neural Inhibitors]] and [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenades]]. These also proved useful when encountering hostile [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. In the final years of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], at what Rislar considered a career low point, the pirate signed up with the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]]. While having an [[Alliance observer]] aboard was not particularly pleasant, the privateer did appreciate the shipping schedules the Alliance provided. Rislar ceased working with the Alliance shortly after it transitioned into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="GFT" />

Years later, Rislar often posted comments on arms and equipment in [[Gundark (arms dealer)|Gundark's]] [[Gundark's Gear Datalog|''Gear Datalog'']].<ref name="GFT" />

==Personality and traits==
Rislar was a reasonably successful commander, having never been challenged for command by crewmembers. This was in part due to the loyalty won by gift-giving. The pirate preferred non-lethal means of securing cargo, but nonetheless was prepared for combat. Rislar's favorite weapon was the [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[T-6 heavy blaster pistol|T-6 "Thunderer" Heavy Blaster Pistol]].<ref name="GFT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rislar appeared in ''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'', a [[West End Games]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] sourcebook published in [[1997]]. Seven comments on the [[in-universe]] message boards used to describe various equipment throughout the book were attributed to the pirate. Rislar's [[Gender/Legends|gender]] and [[Species/Legends|species]] were not identified.<ref name="GFT" />
